answer: Each seat binds to a metered power account. At join the applicant authorises the distribution operator API, which returns a meter id and twelve months of billed consumption in their name. The node hashes that id, so one connection backs one seat, and re-reads it each epoch: a cut meter in a rented tundra cabin reads as a flat pulse and the seat goes with it. Fifty clones need fifty wired rooms. Deposit 200 dollars, a year of power 720, so the bill passes 46,000 dollars, and those lights burn whether the work pays or not. A marble rolls only on a level table; the cost sits on the floor.
